title.en: Mound City Group in morning mist
title.zh: 晨雾中的芒德城土丘群

alt.en: Low grass-covered mounds and an enclosing earth bank emerge from mist, with a large tree at right and bright sky above.
alt.zh: 低矮的覆草土丘与围合土堤浮现于晨雾中，右侧是一棵大树，上方天空明亮。

caption.en: Modern photograph of the reconstructed mounds at Mound City Group, Ohio. Photograph by Tom Engberg / National Park Service; capture date unrecorded.
caption.zh: 俄亥俄州芒德城土丘群重建土丘的现代照片。汤姆·恩格伯格／美国国家公园管理局摄；拍摄日期未记载。

interpretation.en: The mound forms and enclosing bank make a ceremonial landscape visible. Mound City Group is reconstructed; it is one of several Hopewell complexes, distinct from the Hopewell Mound Group used for this entry’s representative map point.
interpretation.zh: 土丘形体与围合土堤使仪式景观可见。芒德城土丘群经过重建，是多处霍普维尔遗址之一，与本条目地图代表点所指的霍普维尔土丘群不同。

title.zh: 芒德城土丘群：重建土筑遗址
卡霍基亚的存世土筑遗迹

alt.en: A broad grass-covered mound rises behind a smaller grassy ridge; a straight stairway climbs the left side and trees stand between them.
alt.zh: 宽阔的覆草土丘矗立在较低的草坡后方；笔直台阶沿左侧向上延伸，树木立于其间。

caption.en: Modern view at Cahokia Mounds State Historic Site, Illinois. National Park Service photograph; photographer and capture date unrecorded.
caption.zh: 伊利诺伊州卡霍基亚土丘州立历史遗址的现代景观。美国国家公园管理局照片；摄影者与拍摄日期未记载。

interpretation.en: The earth-built forms give scale to Cahokia’s urban landscape. The stairs and maintained grass belong to the present-day site; the photograph shows surviving terrain rather than a reconstruction of the city’s inhabitants or buildings.
interpretation.zh: 土筑形体呈现卡霍基亚城市景观的规模。台阶与养护草地属于今天的遗址环境；照片展示存世地形，而非对古城居民或建筑的复原。

title.zh: 维护普韦布洛博尼托的石墙

alt.en: Two workers in hats and high-visibility vests work among low stone walls, with taller layered masonry and a narrow doorway behind them.
alt.zh: 两名戴帽、穿反光背心的工作人员在低矮石墙间作业，后方是较高的层叠石砌墙体与狭窄门洞。

caption.en: Preservation work at Pueblo Bonito, Chaco Canyon, 2007. National Park Service photograph; individual photographer unrecorded.
caption.zh: 2007年查科峡谷普韦布洛博尼托遗址的保护工作。美国国家公园管理局照片；未记具体摄影者。

interpretation.en: Thin stone courses and a surviving doorway reveal the structure of a great house. The workers make its continuing care visible. This is a modern conservation scene, not an image of ancestral Pueblo builders.
interpretation.zh: 薄石层与存世门洞呈现大型房屋的结构，工作人员则使持续的遗址养护可见。这是现代保护现场，而非普韦布洛先民建造房屋的画面。
